title: ViFA-Council: Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation for Vietnamese Folk Art Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.13348v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents ViFA-Council, a three-stage multi-agent framework that employs multiple large language models (LLMs) to tackle two culturally complex generative tasks: image outpainting and educational story generation based on traditional Vietnamese folk paintings. Current single-model generative pipelines frequently struggle with stylistic hallucinations and cultural misrepresentations because they lack mechanisms for cross-model critique. ViFA-Council addresses this challenge by orchestrating collaboration among GPT-4o, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and Claude Sonnet 4.6. It enforces rigorous cultural constraints through structured agent deliberation. This deliberation is mediated by task-specific JSON schemas that effectively bridge natural language discussions with diffusion-based image synthesis using Banana Pro. translated_title: ViFA-Council：基于多智能体大语言模型协商的越南民间艺术生成
translated_abstract: 本文提出了ViFA-Council，这是一个三阶段的多智能体框架，利用多个大语言模型（LLM）来解决两个文化上复杂的生成任务：图像外绘（outpainting）和基于越南传统民间绘画的教育故事生成。当前的单模型生成流程由于缺乏跨模型批判机制，经常出现风格幻觉和文化误表征的问题。ViFA-Council通过协调GPT-4o、Gemini 3.1 Pro和Claude Sonnet 4.6之间的协作来应对这一挑战，并通过结构化的智能体协商来执行严格的文化约束。这种协商由特定任务的JSON模式进行中介，有效地将自然语言讨论与基于扩散模型的图像合成（使用Banana Pro）相连接。实验和用户研究表明，结构化的多智能体协商是提升文化表现力的一个有前景的方向。
tldr: 该论文提出三阶段多智能体框架ViFA-Council，通过GPT-4o、Gemini 3.1 Pro和Claude Sonnet 4.6之间的结构化协商与跨模型批判机制，减少了越南民间艺术生成中的风格幻觉和文化误表征，成功实现了图像外绘和教育故事生成两项任务。
en_tdlr: ViFA-Council is a three-stage multi-agent LLM deliberation framework that orchestrates GPT-4o, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 through structured, JSON-schema-mediated cross-model critique to reduce stylistic hallucinations and cultural misrepresentations in Vietnamese folk art image outpainting and educational story generation.
